text:
marcus: kicking off AtlasPay presales thread. promo spikes expected ~820 rps for 10-20m, baseline ~320 rps. asking guidance on reserved vs burst and safe autoscale.

anya: quick Qs 1) avg token length? 2) model? 3) latency SLOs?

marcus: avg ~200 tokens, mostly chat + some embeddings, prefer 13B quant, target p95 < 800ms, p50 ~200ms.

ricardo: throughput calc: 820 * 200 = 164k tok/s (raw). batching + KV cache must be used to make this feasible. recommend sizing reserved for baseline ~320 rps and a burst pool for +500 rps.

anya: proposed config: reserved 6 GPUs steady, burst credits to cover +500 rps for 15m windows, autoscale policy with fast ramp. sample autoscale snippet to include in proposal: ```json
{"min_replicas":4,"max_replicas":14,"target_rps_per_replica":90,"ramp_cooldown_s":20}
```

ricardo: routing/fallback: default -> quant13; fallback -> fp16 70B if queue_depth > 60 or p95 > 900ms for 30s. preheat KV cache 8-12m before promos (synthetic prefix hits) to reduce token work.

sec-bot: AtlasPay requires customer KMS, audit logs and VPC peering. note: KMS supported on Dedicated/Private; Hosted supports envelope encryption + logs export. include Private option for PHI.

anya: operational runbook bullets: - KV preheat (10m) - burst window cap (15m) - edge 429 + Retry-After policy - monitoring alerts: p95 >1s, queue_depth>100, error_rate>1%.

marcus: finance asked for delta reserved vs on-demand for 12mo. @finance please provide SKU quote and per-token delta.

finance: will do a 12mo reserved quote + burst addon, aim EOD. ballpark reserved ~18-24% unit cost reduction vs pure burst for quant setups.

ops-bot: created doc /ops/poc/atlaspay/surge-plan-v1 for eng-ops review.

marcus: action items: 1) finance quote 12mo 2) ops draft POC runbook + preheat script 3) security KMS + audit appendix. schedule 30-min preflight call with AtlasPay ops tomorrow.

anya: example preheat curl (for runbook):
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/preheat -d '{"prefix":"atlaspay-promo","hits":1}' & done
```

ricardo: will assemble latency vs cost appendix (quant13 vs fp1670) and include in proposal.

marcus: thanks team 1 will draft proposal: reserved 6 GPUs, burst credits +500 rps (15m), autoscale min4/max14, KV preheat, fallback routing, security appendix. sending draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
